info.description: Product / mobile / client app surface. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT. Platform admin and access-management routes live under `/docs/admin`.

post.description: Login user; return tokens, or login_pending when email MFA is enabled.
Complete optional email MFA after password login.
Logout user; revoke JWTs for this account and clear cookies.
Register new user; send activation email if email provided.

get.description: Canonical alias for the authenticated active account.

post.description: Validate password reset OTP and return a short-lived reset token.
Set new password using the reset token from verify-reset-otp or exchange-setup-code.
Exchange an opaque admin setup code for a short-lived password-setup JWT.
Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Return effective permissions embedded in the current access token.

post.description:
Upload an file to R2 storage and create an FileAsset record.

- Accepts multipart form-data with `file` (UploadFile), optional `alt_text`, and optional `folder`.
- Stores the file under `<folder>/<uuid>.<ext>` in R2.
- Returns FileOut with a presigned preview URL (`url`).

get.description:
List files with pagination. Each item includes a presigned `url` for preview.
Optionally filter by `folder` (prefix).

post.description:
Public endpoint for contact form submissions.
Sends an email to the configured project inbox.

get.description:
Get all notifications for the logged-in user.

- Returns notifications ordered by created_at descending (most recent first)
- Supports pagination

patch.description:
Mark a notification as read.

- Only the notification owner can mark it as read
- Updates is_read to True
- Sets read_at to current timestamp
